_: Seam 3. Every load in the society, and what the controller is allowed to do with it. A new appliance, a new flexible asset or a new load type is one entry. The deferrable pool the optimiser is handed is summed from this file at build time — it is not a constant anywhere in the code.
_deferrable_vs_curtailable: Two different permissions, deliberately separate. `deferrable` means the load may be MOVED to another time with its deadline honoured. `curtailable` means it may be REDUCED or SHED. A water pump run at 08:00 instead of 14:00 is deferred, not curtailed, which is why it is deferrable: true and curtailable: false.

devices.why: Thermal storage with a long deadline. Held at 18:30, run at 22:15, hot by 06:00. The single most shiftable load in an Indian society.
Drops to trickle rather than stopping. The deadline is the morning commute, so the night window covers it comfortably.
A cycle, once started, finishes. It can be started later; it cannot be interrupted.
Rare in this society. Present in the registry so the archetype that owns one is modelled rather than approximated.

Fills the overhead tanks. Moving it into the 0.8x solar window never touches the evening peak and is where most of the rupees come from. Never shed: the constraint registry's never_curtail tags include water_pump.
Sewage treatment aeration. Duty-cycled, so the hours may move but the daily total may not fall.
Never deferred, never shed, and it is the load a juror will name first.
Life safety. On the backup circuit during an outage.
Common-area lighting. Small, constant, and shedding it would be visible to every resident for no meaningful kVA.

Curtailable by setpoint rather than deferrable — you widen the deadband, you do not move the afternoon. Held out of the deferrable pool on purpose: the comfort budget governs it, not the scheduler. This is the entry to change if a juror asks for AC setpoint control.
Never touched. Listed so the resident view's 'never touched' panel reads from the registry rather than a hand-written list.
Never touched. Dinner is at the time dinner is.
Oxygen concentrators and the like. Three flats have one registered.
